records.part: Test Antenna Equipment Unit (AEU) with Spares Replenishment
records.reason: This Test AEU will enable hardware and software upgrades to be developed and verified without impacting warfighter missions, resulting in a more mature product and reduced risk of operational downtime.
An operational AEU spare is required to mitigate downtime when a unit experiences AEU failure. The Float AEU temporarily takes the place of an AEU that will be returned for depot-level refurbishment.
